title: Roll Volley Mechanics (Michelle Grogan)
style: progressive trance 134bpm female whisper vocal tribal drums djembe congas taiko horns brass stabs animal calls bird whoop wolf howl ambient pads English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Whisper intro]
They gave you the high ball
At the kitchen line low
Lift with top spin
Dip it at their feet

[Whisper verse]
Feet stop set the base
Knees bend low and load
Paddle low below the ball
Grip pressure five out of ten

Contact in front of the body
Low to high swing path
Brush up the back of the ball
Face closed slightly down

[Tribal drop chant]
Roll the ball roll the ball
Dip and spin dip and spin
Vamos firme pa lante
Roll the ball roll the ball

[Whisper verse]
Landing zone their kitchen
Apex above the tape
Top spin pulls the ball down
Their feet is the target

Follow through up and across
Return to ready balanced
Stay at the line don't drift
Breath out and reset eyes

[Tribal drop chant]
Roll the ball roll the ball
Dip and spin dip and spin
Vamos firme pa lante
Roll the ball roll the ball

[Whisper outro]
Low to high
Brush up
Low to high
Brush up
